### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s).

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`  _(via email_template (symbol, a field of const object esESMetadataForms; a field of const object jaJPMetadataForms))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via email_template (symbol, a field of const object esESMetadataForms; a field of const object jaJPMetadataForms))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json defc7f7b504e22b9e2c12a5374ebb255efe9b7da` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7aa799e489a4c8adbc6f0da95bbc4d8a323cd705` — the merge of head `aaee46778305b33d8afaf19c8243ccc930d04840` into base `defc7f7b504e22b9e2c12a5374ebb255efe9b7da`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7aa799e489a4c8adbc6f0da95bbc4d8a323cd705 && git checkout 7aa799e489a4c8adbc6f0da95bbc4d8a323cd705
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin defc7f7b504e22b9e2c12a5374ebb255efe9b7da aaee46778305b33d8afaf19c8243ccc930d04840 && git checkout -B drift-repro defc7f7b504e22b9e2c12a5374ebb255efe9b7da && git merge --no-ff aaee46778305b33d8afaf19c8243ccc930d04840

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json defc7f7b504e22b9e2c12a5374ebb255efe9b7da
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs defc7f7b504e22b9e2c12a5374ebb255efe9b7da` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aaee46778305b33d8afaf19c8243ccc930d04840`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #20666 (body and all four comments: triage 5893971675, the widening-check note 5894872722, the claim 5896670403, the os-dev-report 5897252407), PR #20707 (body, file list, `git diff origin/main...refs/review/20707` at merge-base `a8acee28d`), the head's check-runs, and `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` on `origin/main` (`735594bea9`; untouched since the merge-base, so it equals the `en` the PR was judged against). The head is still `aaee46778`.

**Check-runs on the head, read once, not polled:** 31 runs, 0 failed. Completed 19: 16 success (Auto Label, Dogfood Verify CLI, Build Core, Type Check debt ledger, Governed Surface Queue Guard, single-writer path, Type Check consumer gates, Flag docs, Type Check source gates, filter, card-claims-branch, single-issue, Check PR Size, Part-of, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links), 3 skipped (Console Pin Gate, Build Docs, Packed-tarball smoke, all opt-in or path-gated). Still `in_progress` 12: Test Core 1-6, Dogfood Regression Gate 1-3, Temporal Conformance, Type Check workspace, Lint and Repo Gates (the run that carries `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill`). Every completed gate is green; the landing still waits for the twelve, as the queue rule already requires.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set: no change — right.** The diff touches no schema, no form declaration and no `en` file: four files, `.changeset/20666-stale-authored-metadata-form-leaves.md` (new) and the ja-JP / es-ES / zh-CN `metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles, 4 value lines each. Key skeleton of each translated bundle is identical to `en` at the head (2516 lines, 1116 string leaves per locale, same key sequence), so it is values only: no key added or dropped. No source-hash companion changes, and none is owed: all six `*.source-hashes*.ts` files carry 0 `metadataForms.` rows at the head, and `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` states that `collectFilledFromHashes` records generated (echoed) leaves, not authored ones. The PR body's ablation (setting one leaf to its `en` string reddens `check-i18n-bundles`, `--write` on the unmutated tree leaves `git status` empty) is the dev's measurement and was not re-run here; the structural facts above are consistent with it.

**Public surface: 12 customer-visible runtime strings in a released package — right to publish under a changeset.** `@objectstack/platform-objects` exports the three bundles; the console renders them. Each re-translated value, judged against the current `en` value of the same key:

- `agent.sections.capabilities.description`, `en` "Skills and knowledge sources the agent can use." — ja-JP, es-ES, zh-CN now say exactly that; the dropped word is tools. `agent.form.ts` section `capabilities` holds `skills` only (ADR-0109 removed `agent.tools[]` at `e2616e0cf`, resolved above). Right ×3.
- `permission.sections.tab_and_row_level_security.description`, `en` "Tab visibility and RLS policies." — ja-JP and es-ES drop the custom context variables (`PermissionSet.contextVariables` gone at `879ea1304`; `permission.form.ts` section holds `tabPermissions` and `rowLevelSecurity` only). zh-CN's old value named the section after sharing rules, which in this repo is `sys_sharing_rule` / `nav_sharing_rules` (共享规则 in `zh-CN.ts` and the plugin-sharing bundle), a different mechanism; the new 标签页可见性与行级安全策略 uses the section's own label word 标签页 and the bundle's rendering of RLS (`object.fields["access.default"].helpText`). Right ×3.
- `report.fields.blocks.helpText`, `en` "Dataset-bound sub-reports (joined report only)" — all three now render that; the old values described a join of several objects (pre-ADR-0021, `18178454c`; `report.form.ts` declares the repeater with this helpText). Right ×3.
- `email_template.sections.identity.description`, `en` "Template identifier resolved by IEmailService.sendTemplate({ template: name, locale, ... })." — ja-JP and es-ES now render that; the old values sent the template by `id` with a content type, neither of which the Identity section holds (`email-template.form.ts`: `name`, `label`, `category`, `locale`, `description`). zh-CN already said it and is unchanged. Right ×2.
- zh-CN `report.sections.joined_blocks.label`, `en` "Joined blocks" — old 关联对象 (related objects) named the retired object-join model over a section whose own zh-CN description already says dataset blocks, so a reader believed the section configured related objects: a contradiction of the current `en`, even though `en` never moved. New joined 报表分块 says what `en` says; its one extra token 报表 restates the section's own scope (`visibleWhen data.type == 'joined'`, and the sibling values' 仅 joined 报表) and claims nothing `en` does not. Right, noted as the least literal of the twelve.

No new value byte-equals its `en` leaf (no echo introduced). No test or ledger asserts any of the old or new strings: `git grep` at the head finds the old strings nowhere outside the three bundles except 关联对象 in driver CHANGELOG prose and in the `reason` prose of one `dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` row (line 309), which no assertion reads (the ledger asserts row count, keys and verdicts). `metadata-forms-vocabulary.test.ts` asserts group keys only.

**Stale-but-not-contradicting leaves left as written — right on each.** Read against `en` in all locales: `object.sections.fields.description` (row vs entry: rewording), `hook.fields.condition.helpText` (translations say optional formula, skip when false; `en` says CEL predicate, runs only when TRUE — the same gate, `hook-wrappers.ts` line 440 `if (!conditionFn(ctx))`, whose own docblock at line 239 calls it a formula; the schema is `.optional()`; no JavaScript claim survives), `app.fields.defaultAgent.helpText` ja/es (AI agent vs Platform agent: narrowing), `report.sections.joined_blocks.description` ja/es (joined into vs stacked into), `report.sections.filter_and_chart.description` (report-level vs render-time scope), `dashboard.fields.refreshIntervalSeconds.label` (unit missing from the label, present in each locale's helpText). Five of the penultimate-edit flags (`object.fields.isSystem.helpText`, `view.fields.filter.helpText`, `app.sections.access_and_sharing.description`, `permission.sections.identity.description`, zh-CN `email_template.fields.variables.helpText`) spot-read: each already says what `en` says. No re-translation in the diff rests on a title-case-only change, per the ruling.

**Ruling compliance:** values only ✓; only contradicting leaves ✓; title-case ruling honoured ✓; no new gate (no script, test or workflow in the file list) ✓; file surface as claimed (5896670403) ✓: not the object bundles, not the plugin bundles, not `{en,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-CN}.ts` or `*.source-hashes.ts`.

**PR body, factual sentences:** line numbers (2251, 2347, 1856, 2151, 1801) true; 12 = 4 + 4 + 4 true; 1116 leaves per locale true; 69 / 70 / 70 first-parent commits per translated bundle before this PR and 56 for `en` true (70 / 71 / 71 at the head, the PR commit included); every cited sha resolves to the commit described (`e2616e0cf`, `879ea1304`, `47a92f427`, `18178454c`, `e9fcd6bbd`, `9f8ec35c8`, `48efe915b`, `ae2da1e7d`, `dc721729a`, `e0077ea36`, `f4ce10c89`); the retired-term 0 reproduces by reading (every ja-JP ロール hit sits under an `en` path that carries role: ARIA roles, the persona Role label, role names; zh-CN and es-ES have no hit whose `en` lacks the term). "origin/main moved two commits past the base" was true when written; a third commit, `735594bea9`, docs-only under `content/docs/**`, has landed since, and none of the three touches a `*.form.ts`, a translation bundle or a companion (the two spec edits are zod `.describe()` strings on flow and http-node maps that the metadata-forms bundle does not carry), so the conclusion still holds. The build, test, gate and ablation counts are the dev's measurements, consistent with everything read and not reproduced here (read-only).

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/platform-objects`: `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, no arm — right. The diff publishes changed runtime strings from a released package and nothing else: no accept-set change (so not `yes`), no removal or rename of anything authorable (so not `(narrowing)`), a bug fix (so `patch`, not `skip-changeset`). `Clause-②: no` appears in the changeset body and in the PR body, and they agree. The package sits in the changeset `fixed` group; a patch on it is the ordinary shape. No model identifier in the changeset, the PR title, the PR body or the commit; the commit ends with the model-free trailer pair AGENTS.md requires. Every factual sentence of the changeset is true against the diff and the forms: the hand-kept-leaf mechanism (stated in the `en` bundle's own header), the two known leaves and the keys that were removed, the twelve-leaf list and its per-locale split, the `name`-resolved template with no content type, the zh-CN section label, "values only: no key is added or removed, and no provenance table changes". `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` is empty. Dev flags from the os-dev-report, each answered:

1. **Instruments beyond the three named** (merge side, retired term, retired concept, carve-in continuity) — accepted. The ruling bounds what may be re-translated (only leaves whose meaning contradicts `en`, values only), not what may be read while measuring; the added scans are read-only, add no gate and touched no file outside the surface. Their zero results are consistent with what was re-read here (retired-term 0 reproduced).
2. **zh-CN `report.sections.joined_blocks.label`, found only by the retired-concept scan** — accepted as within the ruling: the leaf's meaning contradicts the current `en` (judged in ① above), which is the ruling's criterion; the ruling does not require `en` to have moved. The dev listed it separately and the changeset names it. Not escalated.
3. **Stale-but-not-contradicting leaves left as written** — accepted, each judged in ①. The two closest calls (`hook.fields.condition.helpText`, `report.sections.joined_blocks.description`) stay on the right side of the contradiction line; re-translating them would exceed "only the leaves whose meaning now contradicts `en`".
4. **`origin/main` not merged** — accepted. Merge-base `a8acee28d`; `main` is now three commits ahead, none touching a form declaration, a bundle or a companion; the PR is mergeable per the API and the measurement stands on the current `en`.
5. **Three out-of-scope notes, carrier none** — accepted as notes, none blocks: (a) the `dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` reason prose now cites a superseded zh-CN label; verified prose-only, no assertion reads it, and the file is outside the card's surface — a later hygiene edit to that ledger, not this PR; (b) zh-CN `page.sections.data_context.description` 关联对象与变量 over a section holding `object` (bound object) and `variables`: loose, not contradicting; (c) the instrument's blind spot (wrong when authored, `en` never moved) is inherent and already recorded on the family's sibling PR.
6. **Attribution deviation** (model-free commit trailer pair; session-URL PR footer) — correct per AGENTS.md, which outranks the harness reminder; not a deviation to repair.
7. **Worktree removed after the PR opened** — housekeeping; the pushed head equals the reviewed head.

Nothing escalated. No FAIL item.
